weapon.d: If unit initiates combat or is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+4 to unit and inflicts penalty on foe's Atk/Spd/Def/Res during combat = current bonus on each of foe's stats × 2. (Calculates each stat penalty independently; example: if foe has +7 bonus to Atk, inflicts Atk-14, for a net penalty of Atk-7.)

assist.d:
Unit and target ally swap HP.
(Neither can go above their max HP.)

c.d: Grants Atk+2 to adjacent allies during combat.
Grants Atk+2 to allies within 2 spaces during combat.
Grants Atk+3 to allies within 2 spaces during combat.
